column1: # p3a 2.x partition table. Fixed for the life of 2.x: a change here needs a
# serial reflash of every device. Rationale: docs/2.0/DECISIONS.md D1 and
# The fixed-size partitions sit at the front so that the two that might be
# resized one day (the app slots and the spare block) share one boundary.
# Reserved and unformatted. No code uses it. A data partition can be put to
# use later without a reflash; an app slot cannot be grown without one.
